segments.note: ⚠ PARTIAL COLUMN. Col 1837 is LATIN above the printed rule (the tail of Doctrina XXIV, which has no Greek at all) and GREEK below it. Only the D band of this column belongs to the Epistolae. The transcription file already contains the Greek stretch alone.
